metadata.description: 8 production subagents with strict output contracts, plus the briefing and fan-out discipline

plugins.name: goat-herd
plugins.description: Eight subagent definitions with output contracts already written, plus two skills that decide how to use them: a briefing skill that states the output contract literally, bounds scope in both directions, supplies the context a subagent cannot see, and requires self-verification before return; and a fan-out skill that decides whether to delegate at all, splits by artifact so results merge mechanically, and settles the merge and disagreement rules before any agent launches.
